snippet.title: Against the Storm - Nightwatchers DLC Launch Trailer | OUT NOW
snippet.description:
Against the Storm - Nightwatchers DLC is OUT NOW on PC!

Nightwatchers adds new playable species, two new biomes, new world events, modifiers, buildings, mechanics, cornerstones, deeds, and more!

Learn more:
• STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725110/Against_the_Storm__Nightwatchers
• EPIC GAMES STORE: https://store.epicgames.com/p/against-the-storm--nightwatchers
• GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/against_the_storm_nightwatchers
• MICROSOFT STORE: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pn0lcnlkj9l

---------------------------------------------------------------------

Features:
• Manage the Bats — a stern and fiercely devoted species with unmatched resilience and exceptional metallurgical skills.
• Exile sluggish villagers in the Manorial Court to boost the productivity of loyal workers.
• Explore 2 new biomes: the mineral-rich Rocky Ravine and the leafy sanctuary of the Bamboo Flats.
• Tame the unforgiving landscape of the Rocky Ravine, where even the trees are made of stone, and trade on credit at the Black Market to keep your settlement thriving.
• Settle the Bamboo Flats and care for the Fluffbeak’s hunger, thirst, and warmth to keep it happy and earn fertilizer - a key ingredient in producing fertile soil
• Engage in 3 new World Events and confront a tree-devouring Grazer, trigger an explosive experiment, and pay off a criminal group to escape their grasp.
• Claim powerful World Event rewards: from an on-demand syndicate trader to engine-boosting fuel rods, a tireless mining automaton, and the woodcutting Rainpunk Shredder.
• Take on 3 new Modifiers that challenge you to settle in confined space, flourish without geysers, and strategically discard Cornerstones.
• Unlock 3 new Legendary Cornerstones, 16 new Deeds, 6 new Decorations, and new Smoldering City Upgrades.
• Listen to 27 new music tracks, each tailored to bring the new biomes to life.
• And more!

---------------------------------------------------------------------
